meta.title: Optimize Editor Bundle Size with Dynamic Imports and Chunk Splitting
meta.body_summary: Implement React.lazy() and Vite chunk splitting to reduce editor main bundle size by 40% (306.24 kB → 182.37 kB) with on-demand plugin loading.

perf_labels.notes: Devin PR with numeric bundle size claim closed immediately by bot per user request after Netlify Lighthouse showed performance regression (96, down 2).

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 63 changed lines in 2 files, this is a small edit by absolute volume. It fits a targeted frontend build optimization PR that was closed without merge due to a user request, not based on review feedback.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review occurred; the PR was closed by the Devin bot 3 minutes after creation with the comment 'Closing per user request - will create issue for editor optimization instead'.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce main editor bundle size from 306.24 kB to 182.37 kB (40% reduction) using React.lazy() and enhanced Vite chunk splitting.
review_details.antipattern_addressed: large_synchronous_bundle (prior behavior; not in taxonomy enum)
review_details.rejection_signals: User requested closure to create an issue instead; no substantive review of the optimization.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Bundle size optimization with dynamic imports is within Devin's capability, but closure was driven by process (user preference to handle via issue) rather than review-based rejection.

detection_detail.ci_auto: Netlify deploy preview automatically ran Lighthouse audit and reported a performance score of 96 (down 2 from production), indicating a minor regression.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body includes before/after bundle size numbers but no repro steps or profiling data. Automated Lighthouse showed a performance regression rather than improvement, and no human validated any perf claim.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: The Lighthouse performance regression (down 2 points) likely triggered the user request to close the PR and create an issue for further investigation instead of merging.

core_change_summary.description: In packages/editor/src/components/core/Editor.tsx, converted ToolbarPlugin, ShortcutsPlugin, and MarkdownPlugin to React.lazy() components with Suspense fallbacks. In packages/editor/vite.config.ts, added manual chunk splitting to produce separate editor-toolbar and editor-plugins chunks.
change_trajectory: Single commit introduced lazy loading and Vite chunk splitting changes across both files.

review_signals.summary: Devin bot introduction, stating it will automatically address comments and monitor CI.
Netlify deploy preview reported Lighthouse performance score of 96 (down 2 from production), indicating a performance regression.
Closing per user request - will create issue for editor optimization instead.

collaboration_trajectory: Devin opened PR with bundle size optimization and reported 40% reduction.
Netlify bot automatically posted deploy preview with Lighthouse audit showing performance regression (score dropped from 100 to 96).
Devin bot closed the PR after 3 minutes, citing user request to create an issue instead.
